what: One-factor A/B on the Wf-A96 protocol (n_train=200, n_val=64, 5 metals, seed 0, 5 epochs, batch 8, edge-MPNN-residual head): ring-prior formulation count vs per_atom, and bond-head Wf-A72 Operators 2+3 (RBF distance + pair chemistry) vs control.

ring_weight_sweep.note: control is weight 0; the other three are the same run with only ring_template_weight changed.

edge_ring_vs_control.note: Same protocol as the weight sweep.  edge_ring replaces the cycle count with a per-edge ring-membership BCE, whose gradient is intensive in graph density (probe: 0.225 at p=0.50 vs 0.084 at p=0.90, a 2.7x change, against the count form's 7,500x collapse).

per_class_lift.note: PR-AUC divided by the class base rate.  On this cohort SINGLE is 2.36% of candidate pairs, so the Wf-A72 gate 'SINGLE >= 0.7' would require near-perfect ranking; it was already recorded as aspirational in §6.100.

honest_limits: 5 epochs, 1 seed, n_train=200.  This is a direction test, not a quality result; the C7 verdict (SA<=4.5 0.28%, joint gate 0/10,190) was measured on an 18-epoch full-corpus pool and is not overturned by a 5-epoch smoke.
The ring profile is computed on the DECODED val molecules (gen_eval_n x gen_eval_seeds = 96 per epoch), not on the bond head's graph over truth geometry.
Each arm is a single training run, so a delta smaller than the run-to-run spread of this protocol is not interpretable.  No spread is measured here (n_seeds=1).
